events.body:
The GSoC 2027 warm-up hackathon runs from 1 Nov 2026 to 9 May 2027. Its page shows how many Slack messages each participant posted, but only when the stats workflow has Slack tokens. Two Actions secrets are needed:

- `SLACK_TOKEN_OWASP`: a Slack user token for the OWASP workspace, with the `search:read` scope.
- `SLACK_TOKEN_BLT`: a Slack user token for the BLT workspace, with the `search:read` scope.

Both go in the Actions secrets of the [BLT repository](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT) on git.owaspblt.org. A workspace without a token shows "—" on the page, and with no token at all the Slack card is hidden, so this should be done before 1 Nov 2026.

## Steps

1. In each workspace, create a Slack app (or use an existing one) at [api.slack.com/apps](https://api.slack.com/apps), add the user token scope `search:read`, install it, and copy the user token (`xoxp-...`).
2. Add the two tokens as the Actions secrets `SLACK_TOKEN_OWASP` and `SLACK_TOKEN_BLT` in the BLT repository on git.owaspblt.org.
3. Trigger the stats workflow [`.forkmesh/blt-hackathons--update-stats.yml`](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/blob/main/.forkmesh/blt-hackathons--update-stats.yml) by hand (it has `workflow_dispatch`; otherwise it runs every 6 hours).
4. Check that the warm-up page on [hackathons.owaspblt.org](https://hackathons.owaspblt.org/) shows the "Slack messages" card and a Slack count next to the contributors.

See the "Slack activity" section of [`blt-hackathons/README.md`](https://git.owaspblt.org/BLT/blob/main/blt-hackathons/README.md) for how participants are mapped to Slack accounts and how the search is rate-limited.

## Checklist

- [ ] Slack user token with `search:read` for the OWASP workspace
- [ ] Slack user token with `search:read` for the BLT workspace
- [ ] `SLACK_TOKEN_OWASP` added to the BLT repository's Actions secrets
- [ ] `SLACK_TOKEN_BLT` added to the BLT repository's Actions secrets
- [ ] Stats workflow run by hand and finished without Slack errors in its log
- [ ] Hackathon page shows Slack counts
